optimization.action_description: Extend probe_fp4_gemm_layout.py with an optional lower-level mm_fp4(backend='trtllm') stage1 diagnostic and a prepared-layout Python reference check using the same row/scale mapping as the current CUDA candidate.
optimization.expected_impact: Rule out a second shortcut: the standalone TRT-LLM GEMM API can be made callable locally, but it still does not directly reproduce the fused MoE prepared-layout stage1 result on the real G11 input contract.
optimization.risks_and_rollback: The trtllm standalone GEMM probe required a local, uncommitted FlashInfer JIT build.ninja patch adding -include tuple and -include functional. The candidate kernel and default probe path do not depend on that patch.

profile_evidence.evidence_summary: The optional trtllm stage1 probe ran after locally adding missing <tuple>/<functional> includes via JIT flags. On real G11 prepared tensors with T=8, standalone mm_fp4(trtllm) stage1 measured 70.368 us for one expert but returned a non-finite sample; the prepared-layout Python reference sample was -0.953851, so this low-level GEMM API is not a drop-in stage1 replacement.
profile_evidence.evidence_chain: The real fused MoE path uses TensorRT-LLM MoE-specific routing/permutation and prepared layouts. Generic cutlass mm_fp4 produced non-finite prepared stage1 output in v7, and standalone trtllm mm_fp4 also failed the prepared reference diagnostic here. Therefore the next viable implementation must mirror the fused MoE data-prep/grouped-GEMM contract rather than call dense GEMM with the prepared tensors directly.

correctness.details: trtllm_stage1 returned a non-finite sample for the real G11 prepared T=8 probe. prepared_reference_errors reported finite=false.

quality_gate.failure_reason: The low-level standalone TRT-LLM GEMM probe is faster than generic cutlass for one dense expert stage, but it is not numerically aligned and cannot be promoted into the candidate.

next_step.description: Inspect and port the TensorRT-LLM fused MoE grouped-GEMM data-prep contract: packed routing, expert token permutation, MoE-specific A/SF layout, stage1 SwiGLU+FP4 quantization, and fused stage2 finalize/scatter.
